persoenlichkeit.v: He can count everything except the reasons anybody agreed to be counted.

v.vorschlag: English bright precise tenor, delighted certainty

v: We can improve that by counting again.

backstory.v: Dr. Zifferfest uses his brass counter to turn HyperNorm neighbours into an encouraging total. The building recognises measured success and insufficient enthusiasm. The Men in Black request the first; Hunky and Dory keep raising the second. A dissonant card once asked what the number meant. He pressed the button twice, then noticed the resident asking was frightened. For the first time he put the counter down before offering an answer.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Zahl stimmt. Was sie zählt, wird nachgereicht.

persoenlichkeit.v: She remembers the past with admirable accuracy wherever it agrees with her.

v.vorschlag: English warm alto, fond reminiscence hardening at the edges

v: We never needed all these improvements.

backstory.v: Frau Frühergut polishes a sepia mirror until HyperNorm looks like a place where nothing ever went wrong. The Men in Black admire the stable picture; Hunky and Dory offer to remove distracting details. A contradictory card reminded her of the leaking roof. She nearly reported it, then remembered the neighbours who brought buckets. She still says everything was better. Lately she has been leaving buckets where people can find them.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Früher war alles besser. Die undichten Stellen ausgenommen.

persoenlichkeit.v: He welcomes every opinion that can be made to sound like his own.

v.vorschlag: English expansive baritone, over-reassuring smile audible in speech

v: Any objections can be raised more quietly.

backstory.v: Hugo rings his little bell whenever the HyperNorm residents reach agreement, usually before anybody has finished speaking. The Men in Black value the quiet; Hunky and Dory value the minutes saying everyone was delighted. A dissonant card asked whether silence was a vote. Hugo smiled until his face hurt. One neighbour stayed behind to disagree kindly. He has not rung the bell about that conversation, and keeps hoping it will happen again.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Zustimmung war einstimmig. Abweichende Stimmen wurden vertagt.

persoenlichkeit.v: He checks for contamination until even his own certainty looks suspicious.

v.vorschlag: English thin careful tenor, anxious pauses

backstory.v: Herr Makellos dusts the HyperNorm landing with a feather duster he will not allow anybody else to touch. He classifies thoughts as clean or in need of removal, although his own ink fingers complicate the inspection. The Men in Black approve the standard; Hunky and Dory ask him to extend it. A dissonant card stuck to his hand. When a neighbour helped peel it off without judging the stain, he found the method disturbingly effective.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Die Prüfung ist sauber. Der Prüfer wird noch untersucht.

persoenlichkeit.v: She trusts the balance most when nobody has put a need on either side.

v.vorschlag: English smooth assured mezzo, amused confidence

v: A need is not yet an offer.

backstory.v: Mira carries an empty balance through HyperNorm and calls its perfect equilibrium a solution. The Men in Black appreciate how little it asks of them; Hunky and Dory suggest charging for the demonstration. A dissonant card brought a resident with nothing to trade. Mira first explained why the pans must stay level, then quietly offered to carry the residents bag. The balance tilted. Nothing terrible happened, which she finds theoretically inconvenient.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Das Gleichgewicht ist vollkommen. Es liegt ja auch nichts drin.

persoenlichkeit.v: He loves being safe so much that departure feels like a personal betrayal.

v.vorschlag: English soft low baritone, dreamy affection mixed with worry

v: We are quite safe in here.
Is everybody on the correct side?

backstory.v: Ewald holds his padlock as though HyperNorm were a promise that could be kept shut. The Men in Black encourage vigilance; Hunky and Dory have supplied further reasons to stay indoors. He used to report cards that suggested otherwise. One ambiguous card asked whom a locked door protects when a neighbour is outside. He has not unlocked every fear. He has, however, begun checking that nobody is left on the landing before bedtime.

frizzlebob.v: FrizzleBob: Er schließt die Gefahr aus. Die Nachbarn bitte vorher hereinlassen.
